quantityalert.showquantityalert.title: Show quantity available warning.
quantityalert.showquantityalert.description: Enables the quantity available warning feature.

quantityalert.text.title: Cart/Mini cart quantity alert text
quantityalert.text.description: Quantity alert text to show on the cart and minicart. Item attributes should be encolsed with [].
quantityalert.text.default: Item [itemname] does not have [unitsrequested] units in stock. Only [unitsavailable] are available.

quantityalert.pdptext.title: PDP quantity alert text
quantityalert.pdptext.description: Quantity alert text to show on the PDP.
quantityalert.pdptext.default: Quantity entered is more than available. Please review quantity before adding to cart.

quantityalert.mapping.title: Cart line key mapping
quantityalert.mapping.description: Maps the attributes from the cart line to the text to be displayed in the website.

messageText.title: Message variable
messageText.description: The string in the quantity alert message to match the cart line attribute.

cartLineAttribute.title: Cart line attribute (id from fieldset)
cartLineAttribute.description: The name of the attribute present in the cart line model.
